title: Numbers or real products?
hook: Two stated cases: explore the assumptions behind a numerical dominance claim.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the assumptions behind a numerical dominance claim affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines NetGap, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the assumptions behind a numerical dominance claim in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
